gaps.explanation: Gap 32,816 = Street + Sales Tax funds, whose schedules are 'Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis' while the statement (p7) is GAAP. Street: p15 Total resources (inflows) 657,465 vs p7 Street column Total revenues 658,662 (-1,197). Sales Tax: p16 Sales taxes 908,331 vs p7 Sales Tax column 939,950 (-31,619). 1,197 + 31,619 = 32,816 (exact). General Fund combining schedule (p20) 2,369,610 and nonmajor combining statement (p19) 79,605 tie to the p7 columns. No fix.

Street: p15 cash-basis Total charges to appropriations 907,457 (Personnel 275,766 + Operating 122,549 + Capital outlay 509,142) vs p7 Street column Total expenditures 926,323 (-18,866). Sales Tax: p16 1,050,793 vs p7 1,050,792 (+1). 18,866 - 1 = 18,865 (exact). General Fund p20 4,422,427 and nonmajor p19 50,552 tie to p7. No fix.

No business-type revenue is in detail: the ALL FUNDS cash-basis schedule (pp17-18) mixes governmental and enterprise revenues, and the proprietary statement (p10) fund columns Electric Fund, Gas Fund, Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Ethanol Fund and Other Proprietary Funds have no schedule of their own. Added one line per printed non-zero row of each column (Internal Service Fund column excluded, Total column never used): operating revenues Electric 4,083,152 (3,970,875 + 37,328 + 74,949), Gas 1,479,467 (1,477,436 + 2,031), Water 475,860, Sewer 427,298 (425,690 + 1,608), Ethanol 671,552 (670,803 + 749), Other Proprietary 258,793 (239,173 + 19,620) = 7,396,122; interest income 109,398 + 1,082 + 22,073 + 3,420 = 135,973. Total 7,532,095 = statement (exact). Fund transfers (p10) are also added here as other financing lines (no business-type transfers gap row): in 42,000 + 218,487 + 302,777 = 563,264; out 582,000 + 240,000 + 80,000 + 150,000 + 415,627 = 1,467,627; net (904,363) = p10 Total.

gaps.explanation: Business-type detail holds only the combined ALL FUNDS cash-basis budgetary schedule function lines (p17): Electric 3,119,071 + Gas 1,311,727 + Water 398,984 + Wastewater 358,487 (+ Ethanol plant 0) = 5,188,269, a cash budget-basis total for the same funds. Per the per-fund detail rule (combined all-funds schedule replaced by the individual fund columns), these 5 lines are removed and one line per printed non-zero row of each p10 proprietary fund column is added: Electric 4,079,687 + interest expense 102,450 + bond issue costs 46,575 = 4,228,712; Gas 1,391,617; Water 583,185 + interest 25,103 = 608,288; Sewer 543,587 + interest 2,495 = 546,082; Ethanol 105,661 (depreciation); Other Proprietary Funds 274,616 (223,694 + 153 + 45,818 + 4,951). Added 7,154,976 = p10 total operating expenses 6,978,353 + interest expense 130,048 + bond issue costs 46,575. Arithmetic: 5,188,269 + 7,154,976 - 5,188,269 = 7,154,976 = statement (exact).
